remarks: Desirable Stonewood condo rental with two bedrooms and two baths--all fully renovated in 2019. Spacious, open floor plan has wood flooring in living/dining area; walk-out deck; kitchen w/white shaker cabinets and gas stove; primary suite has walk-in closet, private bath w/double sinks and large shower stall; additional bedroom and bath; laundry room, 9' ceilings throughout; covered, gated parking garage with one reserved space and additional parking in outdoor lot. This is a no-smoking condo. Pets considered. Convenient location to shopping, restaurants, I95, Merritt and much more. Softscreen Credit Report to be paid by tenants. Credit score 700+
